title: MSc Computer Science (Negotiated Learning)
description: Flexible one-year MSc for students with an ICT background. Choose from about 80 modules across five streams: Foundations of AI, Networks and Distributed Systems, Software Engineering, Machine Learning and Data Science, and Information and Communication Sciences and Languages.

title: MSc Computer Science (Conversion)
description: Conversion MSc for graduates of other disciplines such as arts, business or social science who want to move into computing. Covers core computer science with options in data science, cloud and distributed computing, software engineering, security and AI, plus a summer practicum. Fee is charged as a full programme fee.

title: MSc Advanced Artificial Intelligence
description: Specialist AI master's from the UCD School of Computer Science, covering machine learning and modern artificial intelligence.

title: MSc Data & Computational Science
description: Graduate course in applied mathematics, statistics and computational science, with project work in data and computational science and an optional research dissertation. Suited to industry or research careers.

title: MSc Information Systems
description: Information systems master's covering information systems foundations, UI/UX design, data analytics basics and natural language processing.

title: MSc Computing Science
description: One-year taught MSc: taught modules in semesters one and two, then a research or development project from May to September.

title: MSc Data Science and Artificial Intelligence
description: One-year MSc in data science and artificial intelligence, open to non-EU applicants only.

title: MSc Artificial Intelligence for Business Transformation
description: One-year MSc on applying artificial intelligence to transform business processes and decision-making.

title: MSc Cybersecurity
description: One-year full-time taught MSc in cybersecurity.

title: MSc Business Analytics
description: One-year MSc from Cork University Business School on using data and AI to improve organisational decisions: designing, building and evaluating analytics solutions to real-world problems.

title: MSc Information Systems for Business Performance
description: One-year MSc on using information systems to improve business performance.

title: MSc in Computing
description: MSc with specialist streams including Data Analytics (statistical data analysis, cloud technologies, data management and visualisation, data mining, machine learning) and Artificial Intelligence (foundations of AI, machine learning, information seeking), each with a practicum.

title: MSc in Electronic & Computer Technology
description: MSc with a major in IoT systems: embedded-to-cloud system design, data analytics, cloud-to-edge orchestration and AIoT for industrial transformation.

title: MSc Computer Science (Data Science / Intelligent Systems / Future Networked Systems / Augmented & Virtual Reality)
description: One-calendar-year MSc for strong computing graduates. Shared core modules plus a specialist strand: Data Science, Intelligent Systems, Future Networked Systems, or Augmented & Virtual Reality, then a dissertation over the summer.

title: MSc Business Analytics
description: One-year business analytics master's from Trinity Business School.

title: MSc Computer Science - Artificial Intelligence
description: One-year 90-credit MSc: core modules in programming for AI, natural language processing, machine learning, deep learning, information retrieval, AI ethics, and agents and reinforcement learning, plus electives and a capstone project.

title: MSc Computer Science - Data Analytics
description: MSc in data analytics within computer science, covering large-scale data analytics and machine learning.

title: MSc Artificial Intelligence and Machine Learning
description: One-year full-time MSc combining established AI techniques with emerging areas such as deep reinforcement learning, causality modelling, probabilistic programming and explainable AI.

title: MSc Software Engineering
description: One-year full-time MSc on building robust, large-scale software systems, with a specialisation in either Software Process and Analysis or Data Analytics and a substantial final project.

title: MSc Computer Science (Applied)
description: Applied computer science master's from Maynooth University's Department of Computer Science.

title: MSc Data Science and Analytics
description: Data science and analytics master's from Maynooth University's Department of Mathematics and Statistics.

title: MSc Computer Science (Data Science)
description: MSc at Grangegorman for working with large amounts of raw data: machine learning, data mining, visualisation and research skills. Runs over 1 or 1.5 years.

title: MSc Data Analytics
description: One-year full-time MSc in data mining, statistics and machine learning with a research project. An advanced technical route for computing graduates.

title: MSc Computing in Human Centered Artificial Intelligence
description: MSc on building and applying AI responsibly: AI trustworthiness, AI ethics and socially aligned AI design, developed with a European consortium. Non-EU intake in January.
